_help: Archetypes are only a guide for choosing talents. 'id' must match the 'group' of the talents in talents.json.

archetypes.name: Agent
archetypes.description: Spies, informants, detectives – vigilance and trickery.

archetypes.name: Alchemist
archetypes.description: Crafting, lore, bombs, cooking, potions, ingestibles, mutations.

archetypes.name: Assassin
archetypes.description: Stealth and acrobatics, killing single targets, climbing and parkour.

archetypes.name: Brute
archetypes.description: Barbarian, strength, brawler, unarmed combat, wrestler, grappler.

archetypes.name: Cleric
archetypes.description: Devotee to a god, religion, cults, preacher.

archetypes.name: Companion
archetypes.description: Animal companions and talents that relate to companions.

archetypes.name: Inquisitor
archetypes.description: Anti-magic, controlling magic – basically a mage hunter or detective.

archetypes.name: Knight
archetypes.description: Armor, honorable combat, sense of obligation, paladin, oath, protector.

archetypes.name: Necromancer
archetypes.description: Weaver magic with the Life element – using life for power.

archetypes.name: Shaman
archetypes.description: Nature, closeness to animals, grove tenders, spirituality, elements, curses.

archetypes.name: Thief
archetypes.description: Looting, gathering items, picking locks, breaking and entering, pickpocketing.

archetypes.name: Weaponsmaster
archetypes.description: Everything relating to weapons and specific weapons.
